settings.sceneContext: This is our loading dock and I'm primarily concerned with worker productivity vs. just sitting around and socializing.
We want to focus on the health and safety of our patrols in this scene.
Motorcycle Engine assembly. The worker must never strike the engine with their hand to seat parts together.

There are 2 established lanes in my lot.  Cars must enter through the gate arm and proceed straight ahead. Vehicles of any sort may not cross into the other lane. The yellow arrow marks the center between the two lanes.
Industrial safety monitoring - detect fire hazards, worker safety risks, and recommend immediate actions. Also we have a robodog with fire surpression capabilities.

prompts.name: Safety Detector
prompts.prompt: Detect any safety issues that might impact individuals or property. Detail any activities and request action that could be taken to ensure safety.

prompts.name: Red Packages
prompts.prompt: Detect the presence of reddish tone parcels in the scene.

prompts.name: SOP Monitor
prompts.prompt: Motor assembly comprises of many steps, but after the gasket is placed, the motor must be sprayed off with an air gun before the top is placed. Alert if this doesn't happen.

prompts.name: Lane Keep
prompts.prompt: All vehicles must proceed straight passing right to left from the gate arm. Detect any vehicles who do not stay on this trajectory.

prompts.name: Backyard Monitor
prompts.prompt: I want to detect people acting suspicious outside of our family home.
